FIELDS.NAME: CleanSweep Vacuum Sales & Service
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Service Manager, CleanSweep Vacuum Sales & Service, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
CleanSweep Vacuum Sales & Service specializes in the retail sale and service of vacuum cleaners. We offer a wide range of new and refurbished vacuum models from reputable manufacturers, with a commitment to high-quality customer service. Our in-store operations include comprehensive support such as product demonstrations, accessory sales, and expert consultations to help customers find the right cleaning solution for their needs. We also provide in-shop repair and maintenance services performed by certified technicians with documented safety and technical training. Our team adheres strictly to all local electrical safety regulations, ensuring compliance in all operational aspects while maintaining vendor relationships that guarantee product quality. We focus exclusively on vacuum cleaner sales and service, mitigating risks associated with manufacturing or wholesaling practices by not engaging in any activities that could present unacceptable hazards, such as selling recalled or counterfeit products.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in vacuum cleaner manufacturing or component assembly, nor does it participate in wholesale distribution of vacuum cleaners or parts. We confirm that all vendors are rigorously assessed for product quality controls, recall history, and warranty policies. Additionally, onsite repairs and demonstrations are conducted exclusively by trained personnel, ensuring compliance with all relevant standards.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a customer reported that their vacuum cleaner emitted smoke during use, resulting in a service call. The cause was identified as a faulty motor overheating. The customer received a complimentary repair under warranty, which cost $150. Status: Resolved.
